# Codegen & plugin

Codegen turns the JSON contract into a nested Swift enum tree of compile-time-safe
constants. Rename a key in JSON → regenerate → the compiler flags every stale
reference. That is what eliminates drift on the developer side.

## CLI: `tandha generate`

```bash
tandha generate automation-ids.json --output Generated/AutomationID.swift
```

Given:

```json
{ "login": { "username_field": "login.username_field", "submit_button": "login.submit_button" } }
```

it produces:

```swift
// Generated by tandha — do not edit.
public enum AutomationID {
    public enum login {
        public static let usernameField = "login.username_field"
        public static let submitButton  = "login.submit_button"
    }
}
```

### Options

| Option | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| `--output <file>` | Write to a file (default: stdout) |
| `--root-name <name>` | Rename the root enum (default: `AutomationID`) |
| `--access <level>` | `public` or `internal` (default: `public`) |
| `--no-doc-comments` | Omit doc comments derived from `description` / `screen` |

Namespace keys become nested `enum`s; leaf keys become camelCased `static let`
constants. Swift keywords are back-tick escaped, leading digits are sanitized, and
`description` / `screen` metadata becomes doc comments.

## SwiftPM build-tool plugin

Prefer to never run `generate` by hand? Add the plugin:

```swift
.target(
    name: "App",
    plugins: [.plugin(name: "TandhaCodegenPlugin", package: "tandha")]
)
```

Then drop a file named `*.automationids.json` into the target's sources — for example
`Sources/App/app.automationids.json`. On every build the plugin regenerates the
`AutomationID` enum and compiles it in. (1)
{ .annotate }

1.  The generated file lives in the plugin's work directory, not your source tree —
    there is nothing to check in, and it can never go stale.

!!! tip "Multiple contract files"
    Both the CLI and the plugin accept several JSON inputs, merged by namespace — split
    a large contract per screen or per team and they combine into one enum tree.
